actions.label: Explain how to restore GPU and Network bands

comment.body: Thanks for clarifying that GPU and Network are the missing entries. These Performance Monitor metrics were intentionally split into separate dock bands in the current release rather than removed. Right-click the Command Palette dock, choose **Edit Dock**, and add the GPU and Network bands where you want them. If either band is still missing or displays without an icon after being explicitly added, please share a screenshot of Edit Dock and the resulting band so that separate rendering problem can be tracked.
